title: walsura trifoliolata

It has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Walsura trifoliolata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include limonoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
